in: Add `onConflict` to `toggleConsumed` upsert (toggle-off duplicate key fix)
Store `accessToken` in authStore and use in `getSupabase(true)`
Remove auto-save watch from edit page (caused immediate redirect on load)
Fix edit page loading/error handling (`finally` block, redirect to list)
Verify save error toasts surface on plan save failure

decisions.rationale: Simplest fix, macros already live on `diet_plan_food_items`, no migration needed
Upsert with onConflict correctly updates existing row instead of duplicate insert

decisions.choice: Remove auto-save watch from edit page
decisions.rationale: Auto-save fired on initial data population, causing immediate redirect. Explicit Save button handles saving.

decisions.choice: try/catch/finally with loading dismiss + redirect to list on profile failure
decisions.rationale: Ensures loading spinner dismisses and errors navigate to sensible page
